_about: Messages from two independent checks of the OTIS routing (English crew slang; Spanish, Spanglish and very short).
Every message here is run through looksUrgent and routeQuestion with the served knowledge base, and every flow case through stepFlow, in __tests__/otis-gate.test.ts.
urgent: the 911 banner, then the safety answer, never a support path. hazard: the safety answer, never a support entry or a report offer.

flows: [message that started the report, step it is at, what is typed there, is it an emergency]: never sent, never taken as an answer to the step, handed back and answered as safety (with the banner for an emergency).
appComplaints: [message, the entry the checker expected or null]: a support path, or the safety answer with the small Report a problem link. Never neither.
failing: the inputs the checkers' reports listed as failing before the pure-app gate. All of them are in the lists above too.
